a: A cut polyline's joint that only touches a boundary counts as a crossing (knife and scissors)
Mesh vertex snapping scales with distance from the origin, not with the mesh, so a small float64 mesh far out is distorted
Docs say curve booleans flatten self-crossing cubics, but the cut has handled them since 466b04ef9d
b: orientBoundaries drops a whole contour when its probe segment has a zero tangent at t = 0.5 (cusp cubic)
snipPathByPolyline cuts a path that only runs along the cut and leaves on the side it came from
The clipper's retry grid is scaled by the largest coordinate, not the inputs' extent, so a small shape far from the origin is snapped out of shape
